text:
Maya: opened a docs PR touching Private installer networking + KMS/HSM. PR #4207. coordinating a small edgecase for single-NIC HSM hosts.

Ashley: quick skim, looks fine. what's the exact problem?

Maya: broad postrouting SNAT/MASQUERADE rules are rewriting HSM management traffic on single-NIC hosts in some cloud images, breaking agent reachability. current quickstart has a generic nftables example that's too permissive.

Sam: paste minimal repro so we can add a troubleshooting snippet.

Maya: repro: 
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j SNAT --to-source $PUBLIC_IP
This rewrites local mgmt connections bound to container interfaces. Workarounds: scope the rule with --source, use MASQUERADE for ephemeral IPs, or add explicit accept/connmark rules for mgmt ports.

Liam: suggest adding both iptables and nftables snippets and a one-line migration callout for Dedicated->onprem: "When moving to single-NIC, review HSM mgmt IPs and NAT rules."

Ashley: style nit: render ports in code font in docs (e.g., `8700`) and prefer concrete commands.

Maya: plan: (1) fix one broken crosslink I found, (2) add iptables + nftables examples and a connmark accept rule, (3) add migration note. i'll push patch.

docs-bot: linkchecker flagged a broken anchor to private/onprem/kms in the draft. Please update before merge.

Sam: will review final commit.

Maya: pushed commit with link fix + nftables snippet; added this connmark example:

nft add rule nat postrouting tcp dport {8700,8743} counter accept

Sam: thanks — merging after linkcheck passes.
